services.title: Tires and wheels
services.body: Fitting, balancing and rotation on the machine, with the weights set where they belong.

services.title: Brakes
services.body: Pads, rotors and calipers are checked as a set and the worn ones come off beside the new ones, so you can see what was actually changed.

evidence.text: It's worth driving from Clemson or Oakway to have tires replaced or brakes changed .

reviews_h2: What people are saying about the tire / auto

reviews.author: Molly W
reviews.text: This place is good. They have good prices. They don't charge a crazy amount for labor. I got all 4 of my tires changed. I got the 70 thousand mile, for $640, that includes everything. They ordered them for me and they were there the next day. Its a first come first serve. But they get you in and out efficiently and quickly. They are also very nice and hard working people.

reviews.author: Kenneth Cox
reviews.text: The owner snd the employees here are hands down some of the best around....super friendly and always glad to help!!!

reviews.author: Jeff Holland
reviews.text: Brooks tire is the best tire shop around Oconee. It's worth driving from Clemson or Oakway to have tires replaced or brakes changed . The people who work there are friendly and get you in and out . Go and visit on your next tire needs it's worth it.

reviews.author: Benjamin Quirk
reviews.text: I always know I’m going to get quality service at a reasonable price when I go to Brooks Tire Co. Though I had a leak in a front tire they found it, plugged it and got a tire rotation for $23

reviews.author: Marvin Alexander
reviews.text: Yesterday was the first time I went to Brooks to get new brakes, and repair. I'm happy to report that it won't be the last time I'll go to get my brakes done. The price was fair, and job was excellently done.

reviews.author: Greg Carver
reviews.text: Brooks Tire and Recapping has been in Walhalla South Carolina for many years. Great place with great service. They plug tires and sell used and new ones. I went to school with the owner, Very good friendly hometown people to deal with. Keep your money in your local community to help the economy of the local area.

reviews.author: Mamie Harris
reviews.text: If I could give more than 5 stars I would. These guys went above and beyond. They answered all my questions and made sure I felt comfortable with the service. The price was beyond reasonable and I would definitely recommend this tire shop to anyone.

reviews.author: Keith Plott
reviews.text: These are the most kind and caring folks I’ve dealt with. Jeremy and Grace were very helpful. They got the wheel baron replaced on my Suburban and ready for our next adventure. And if you need tires, check them out! Great job Brooks Tires! I will be back, good Lord willing.

reviews.author: Steve Skillings
reviews.text: Super nice people and helpful. I had planned to pick up my car on Tuesday and work got in the way, since they are closed Wednesday I thought I'd have to pick it up Thursday and they still met me at the shop early Wednesday AM to pick up my car. I will definitely use them again and again.

reviews.author: Cynthia Coward
reviews.text: Thank you Jeremy for a very entertaining yet professional experience. Jeremy is knowledgeable and patient working in 100° + heat index, he never slowed or complained. The whole experience was exceptional.

reviews.author: Raul Lopez
reviews.text: Great people at Brooks Tire! Always go there for quick, friendly service at a good price! Will be coming back for more big rig tires! If you’re in the area look no further Jeremy from Brooks is your guy!

reviews.author: Ry Car
reviews.text: Staple of the town. Jeremy and crew are top notch. Honest, fast, fair and thorough. You cant go wrong at Brooks.

reviews.author: samantha webb
reviews.text: Always a pleasure doing business with Brooks Tire. Jeremy is always very friendly and knows his stuff. All the staff are hard working folks.

reviews.author: Kathy Webb
reviews.text: Thank you James for putting a plug in my tire you are always so sweet and very polite. I had let Mrs. Brooks know that I appreciate you. I highly recommend Brooks Tire .

reviews.author: toby johnston
reviews.text: They were very busy but we're very friendly and maintained communication with each customer regularly. I will definitely be returning!!!

reviews.author: Joey Phifer
reviews.text: The guy’s at Brooks are an awesome bunch. They do a great job and always sell you what you ask for and they don’t try to up charge you on something you don’t need like the big box stores have. The best part is they treat you like somebody.I have been in many tire shops in the past that doesn’t care about the customer. All they care about is money and that’s it. Keep up the good work guys.

reviews.author: Richard Barber
reviews.text: This family owned business always offers quality service at very fair pricing. These guys and gals are friendly and helpful to everyone. This is where I get all my tire work done.

reviews.author: K. Buzz
reviews.text: Be careful with this place! I should’ve known better when I saw the disaster area the shop was but we were there for what I thought was a simple fix, all we needed was a valve stem replaced. I left needing a new rim!!! They actually cracked the rim and tried to tell me it was already like that! Which was not true! They refused to accept blame and now a valve stem has cost me a new rim.

reviews.author: Judy Gilmore
reviews.text: I am new to the area and needed my tires rotated. I asked on FB where was a good place and. Brooks got the most favorably post . After going there today I can see why. Service was quick and very efficient. They will get all my business in the future.

reviews.author: Wanda Freeman
reviews.text: These guys are awesome. I went by there yesterday to get my tires checked and I was in and out of there so quick and they didn’t even charge me. And let me begin to tell you how nice they were. That means the world Thank you so much guys.

reviews.author: Haley Meares
reviews.text: These guys are awesome! One of the most honest places around. Not to mention they remember you and your car, which I think makes for a great buisness/consumer relationship. They even stayed late for me one day when I was running late to pick up my car. I wouldn't trust anybody else with this type of work.

reviews.author: Andrew Murray
reviews.text: Fantastic people, prices, and service; also very timely at what they do. Will definitely come here anytime I ever need tires

reviews.author: Edward Hamilton
reviews.text: Jeremy did a great job on my brakes. Great price, fast service, and friendly conversation. What else could you ask for?

reviews.author: Ivan Garcia
reviews.text: These guys do an AMAZING job, I used to travel all the way to Spartanburg for my wheels because places around here tend to chip/scratch the rims. I took my brand new Aodhan here to get some new tires and they did everything in the span of 2 days which is awesome. My rims have no damage at all. On top of all that they give the best prices in town. Super happy with my wheels thanks to these amazing people.

reviews.author: Carsyn Little
reviews.text: These are the fastest Tire folks in Oconee County they'll get you done right quick and affordable they do disc brakes too. Very kind and polite folks honest people

reviews.author: Weld Life
reviews.text: Deff recommend this place for anybody's tire needs. Small family owned business that still believes in hard work and honest prices. Been my tire place for over 15 years now and will continue to be for as long as they are in business. Thank you Brooks tires for all of the honesty and hard work!

reviews.author: Jessica Price
reviews.text: The absolute greatest place ever and anyone who just drives right past them thinking they are just some hole in the wall is passing up some of the friendliest people I've met in a long time, as well some of the most helpful and honest. I would recommend them to anyone and everyone. I had been from 1 shop to the next that day trying to find someone who would take the time and mount this set of tires I had purchased for my truck. Every shop I went to starting all the way in Clemson kept telling me no that it was almost closing time. By the time I made it here it was already after 5, they were actually closed by their hours of operation and I didn't even realize it till after I asked so I was expecting another no. To my surprise even though the time the young gentleman never missed a beat. He unloaded my tires, jacked my truck up, and went to work. Of course to add salt to the wound it starts raining and as well there was a screw in one of the tires I had purchased off line. Even with everything going on they were some of the friendliest people I personally had ever met. At the end the bill was outstanding as well considering all they did. They dismounted, mounted, balanced, and plugged, all this for only $55. They were God sent that day and I hope he does nothing but bless them with the wonderful things they deserve. Because of them not looking at that big clock I was able to drive that 500 miles there and then 500 back with the piece of mind that I was not going to have a tire blow out, which the others would have and that is guaranteed, and leave myself stranded all alone as a female on the side of the interstate. God Bless all of you with nothing but his loving grace and keep up what y'all are doing. Y'all were my guardian Angel's that day and I'm sure the day will come again where you as well be someone elses!! With complete gratitude, Jessica (Chevy 2500HD with the LT37x13.5/r18)

reviews.author: robert sawicki
reviews.text: They are very hospitable, and a pleasure to deal with. I have not bought tires anywhere else since 2008. Guessing I have purchased at least 10 sets of tires there. Nothing they have done has changed my mind!

reviews.author: Duane Miller
reviews.text: This is a great family owned shop. Their prices are fair and they work hard to get you back on the road quickly!

reviews.author: Erin Brewer
reviews.text: They were very nice, and helped me get the brakes fixed on my car without any problem! Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Debra Bowling
reviews.text: Great service and very helpful. Have gotten my tires here before and today needed air. They fixed me right up, were very nice and no change to. Older female, who really appreciates the help. Thanks!

reviews.author: jonathan Raleigh
reviews.text: Fast, people were great and they did an awesome job. Recommend them very highly. They have all my business. Outstanding!!!

reviews.author: Josh Mangan
reviews.text: Awesome as always! Good prices and know what they're doing. Friendly and fair. I always come here when I need tire work done.

reviews.author: Chuck
reviews.text: Don't judge a book by it's cover. Brooks tire is one of the best places to git 'er done. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Melisa Barnes (Little bit)
reviews.text: I needed new tires so I ordered them and got them put on today and had a issue with one of my tire lug nuts so they fixed it also and I appreciated them doing that for me. Now my Tracker drives so smooth thank y'all so much!

reviews.author: Mickey Simpson
reviews.text: Always helpful, always reasonable. Not slow but they do get busy sometimes. They are my go to tire store. Headed there today for a new set before vacation.

reviews.author: Christina Eggleston
reviews.text: Fantastic service as always! Friendly and honest technician's. I highly recommend Brooks Tire. We moved to the area neatly 7 years ago and this is the only place we purchase our tires!

reviews.author: Christina M
reviews.text: The people are very nice, quick to work you in/out and the prices are fair. Definitely recommend this place.

reviews.author: Lewis
reviews.text: We went there on Tuesday to purchase a new tire for our car. They had to order it so I even paid in advance. They were going to be closed the next day on Wednesday so they did loan me a used tire to get back home on because mine was flat and no way to repair the leaks. They said it would be there Thursday by 11:30 a.m. . We went there Thursday and there was no tire to be found that was ordered for us. They had to order again and we had to make another trip up there the next day to get it put on the car. That was unfortunate but everyone makes mistakes and this tire store is a family-run business that has been passed down from Paul Brooks who was a wonderful Christian man Who Would stop whatever he was doing at that time and take time to pray 4 an individual that was asking him to pray for him. A very good man. Not too many people would totally pause their business 2 pray with an individual coming up there and Ashton Paul to pray with him. Support this store because Paul's hard work and his legacy is passed down and hopefully his children and grandchildren and in-laws can keep up the spirit that Paul did

reviews.author: Dagmar Faircloth
reviews.text: A friend recommended this place seven years ago when we moved into the area. Been doing business with them since then and have never been disappointed.

reviews.author: Kathy Capsouto
reviews.text: fast and fairly priced fix of puncture in my time. So grateful to find them open on Saturday morning. thank you

reviews.author: Milton Robinson
reviews.text: Great place to buy tires. Friendly service. Alot better than Supper Service next door. If you want a great price on tires and people you can (Trust) stop here.

reviews.author: Joyce Collins
reviews.text: These guys are great! Fast, friendly, knowledgeable, honest and best prices in town! They remember customers and their vehicles.

reviews.author: Ryan Carver
reviews.text: I have been using Brooks for a while. I've taken everything from tractor tires to UTV tires. I just got 4 new tires installed. They go out of their way and above and beyond to help.

reviews.author: Caitlyn Ellis
reviews.text: This place is awesome for anything related to your tires. Their prices are amazing and the service is awesome. Definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Coty Carver
reviews.text: BEST TIRE SHOP AROUND. JEREMY IS THE MAN TO SEE ANYTIME YOU NEED ANYTHING DONE. TRUST ME. ASK FOR JEREMY.

reviews.author: Sharon Buckles
reviews.text: Just needed to have a tire mounted on boat trailer rim(had blowout driving down from Charlotte for the week.) Got right to me, no waiting!

reviews.author: Greg Smith
reviews.text: They helped me out, finding the size and style tires for my jeep that fit in my budget. Everyone there was friendly and made it a good experience .

reviews.author: Kristy Davis
reviews.text: There is no other place in oconee county to get tires. Price, service, hospitality can not be beat!!

reviews.author: Slocurve
reviews.text: I couldn't believe the length Jeremy went to get me back on the road. Especially since it was a Friday night and I know he was needed at home by his family.

reviews.author: Sam Hancock
reviews.text: I have had all kinds of tires (truck, Jeep, Tractor, etc) mounted here and they are super reasonable and friendly.
